minecraft:written_book_content.title: The Library
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Minecraft
pages: The Great Libraries were a place of vast knowledge and unimaginable power, thought to be lost a long time ago. Now, here you stand, bearing witness to a mere fraction of the power that those lost libraries must have held.

This humble Library still contains its own echoes of the past, remnants of powers unknown. You sense the greatness of this simultaneously miniscule, and yet significant place, which only makes you wonder…
If this library could survive, could there be more out there, yearning to be discovered?
